name: SSSL
tagline: Short, short, short, long. The historical reference.
description: The existing nanochat d24 model uses an SSSL schedule: three local-attention layers followed by one full causal layer, with a final long-window layer. Its historical runs, checkpoints and cost definitions are preserved. It is distinct from the planned all-layer full-attention Dense Baseline.
mechanism: 24 independent blocks, each with its own parameters
Native SSSL window schedule, ending with a long-window layer
A common data budget and evaluation protocol
limitations: Historical SSSL measurements are not results for the new full-attention Dense Baseline. The reference ledger and historical matrix estimate also use different accounting rules.
